projects.name: metricregistry
projects.description: A KPI registry in which each metric is stored as executable, versioned SQL with an owner, grain and tolerance. A divergence monitor compares definitions of the same subject and alerts when they drift apart.
highlights: Flags any pair whose gap exceeds the tighter of the two tolerances (default 0.5%)
Demo surfaces a 6.80% gap between marketing and registrar enrolment counts
16 tests check definitions against independent ground-truth counts

projects.name: Enterprise Customer Management Platform
projects.description: A B2B CRM covering accounts, contacts, interactions and a deal pipeline, with four-role access control. It runs on a Spring Boot REST API and a React SPA, and deploys to AWS ECS Fargate with Terraform.
highlights: Pipeline dashboard runs nine SQL aggregate statements behind a 60-second cache
Six composable filters each on contacts and accounts, with page size capped at 100
Two-level authorization across four roles, plus audit columns on every record

hero.caption: Concept render

projects.name: Real-Time Fraud Detection Pipeline
projects.description: A streaming pipeline that scores transactions with a weighted multi-rule fraud engine on PySpark Structured Streaming. It dual-writes results to Cassandra for real-time lookups and to Redshift for analytics.
highlights: Five weighted rules: high amount, velocity, geo anomaly, card testing and time anomaly
14 unit tests passed across 6 test suites
Dead letter queue for failed records, with Grafana fraud-rate monitoring

hero.caption: Concept render

projects.name: SupportIQ Analytics
projects.description: A customer support analytics dashboard that categorizes tickets, scores sentiment and forecasts ticket volume, so teams can plan staffing and track agent performance.
highlights: Forecasts ticket volume 7 days ahead
Sentiment scoring with VADER, plus sentiment trend charts
Customer health scores and an agent performance leaderboard

projects.name: MedInsight Healthcare Analytics
projects.description: A predictive analytics dashboard that identifies patients at high risk of 30-day readmission before discharge. It includes risk stratification and population health views.
highlights: Random Forest model listed at 85.2% accuracy and 0.89 AUC-ROC
Model draws on 50+ features from demographics, clinical data and patient history
SHAP explainability for each risk score

projects.name: FlavorMetrics
projects.description: A restaurant analytics platform that turns POS and operational data into menu engineering, demand forecasting, food cost tracking and customer segmentation.
highlights: Menu engineering matrix of profitability versus popularity
7-day cover predictions and item-level demand forecasts
RFM segmentation and churn prediction for customers

projects.name: FraudShield
projects.description: An e-commerce fraud detection system that scores transactions with an ML ensemble and a customizable rule engine. It includes an anomaly dashboard and case management for flagged transactions.
highlights: XGBoost classifier listed at 98.2% accuracy
Analyzes 100+ signals per transaction
Isolation Forest model for detecting new fraud patterns

projects.name: WealthWise Robo-Advisor
projects.description: A robo-advisor that builds portfolios from a risk assessment, then handles rebalancing, tax-loss harvesting and goal-based planning.
highlights: Monte Carlo retirement simulation across 10,000 market runs
Rebalancing triggers when allocations drift more than 5%
Efficient frontier and Sharpe ratio optimization

projects.name: TalentFlow
projects.description: A recruitment pipeline platform with resume parsing, semantic job matching, interview scheduling and funnel analytics for spotting hiring bottlenecks.
highlights: Pipeline analytics with stage conversion rates and average time per stage
Semantic candidate matching with sentence-transformer embeddings
Diversity metrics tracked by pipeline stage
